{{Top|leg}}
'''Power gloves''' were a type of thin, energized [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] used by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]], usually while restraining [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].<ref name="BOSSK">{{StoryCite|story=The Prize Pelt: The Tale of Bossk|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref><ref name="ECLIPSE">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref> A stormtrooper using a pair was capable of physically manhandling an uncooperative [[Trandoshan]] prisoner, as was the case for [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]].<ref name="BOSSK" />

In [[Hapan|Hapes]] culture, power gloves were worn in conjunction with other armor pieces as standard attire in [[honor duel]]s.<ref name="ECLIPSE" /> These energized gloves were capable of severely shocking an opponent as well as breaking [[Bone/Legends|bones]]; when a blow landed it sounded like the muffled report of a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]], with the force generated being enough to send an adult human male backward several meters.<ref name="ECLIPSE" />
